items.topic: EIP-8130 的 gas 计算修正
items.title: EIP-8130：创建账户时对初始 actor 槽写入计费
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交并合并。创建条目的 `initial_actors` 会写入存储（每个 actor 一个 `actor_config` 槽），但此前 `account_changes_cost` 只统计配置变更和委托条目，创建条目只按字节码收费，因此通过创建条目注册 N 个 actor 的槽写入是免费的。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: charge initial actor slot writes on account creation
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted and merged. A create entry's `initial_actors` are written to storage (one `actor_config` slot per actor), but `account_changes_cost` only counted config change and delegation entries, and a create entry was charged for bytecode alone, so registering N actors through a create entry got the slot writes for free.

items.topic: EIP-8130 的 gas 计算修正
items.title: EIP-8130：澄清 intrinsic gas 表是推荐值
items.note: 提交：`AA_BASE_COST`、`nonce_key_cost` 表、calldata 费用、槽写入费用等反映当前 EIP-2929/EIP-2028 成本，不是固定的协议常量。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: clarify the intrinsic gas schedule is a recommendation
items.note_en: Submitted: `AA_BASE_COST`, the `nonce_key_cost` table, calldata costs, slot write costs and so on reflect current EIP-2929/EIP-2028 costs and are not fixed protocol constants.

summary_en: nerolation listed EIP-8131, EIP-8146 and EIP-8250 (keyed nonces) as Hegotá PFI and it was merged, and EIP-8131 was rewritten the same day as a unified transaction content floor. EIP-8130 fixed an intrinsic gas undercount: storage slots written for initial actors at account creation were not charged. Jesse Pollak announced privacy on Base powered by Base Ledgers. asanso published a paper on algebraic attacks against Poseidon and Poseidon2. zsfelfoldi submitted EIP-8304.
